stressTest.note: All five model/effort settings have actual final task readings. Only accepted, independently reviewed completed apps enter the accepted-app average and capability matrix. Spend-only readings are actual task costs, not accepted-app prices or zero capability scores.
stressTest.scope: Eight areas; multi-line virtual requests; versioned approvals; budget reservations; partial fulfilment; exact-pence pricing; stale-view guards; atomic price imports; light/dark desktop and mobile interaction. No live business or profile connector.
stressTest.scoreNote: Core acceptance and ten advanced challenges are separate. Each check is worth ten points; every frozen subcase must be verified for an advanced pass. Fail, blocked and untested each earn zero. No combined quality-per-credit score.
stressTest.guidanceNote: Four identical planned prompts per app. Early corrections are included in first-complete-target cost; it is not necessarily a no-guidance first pass. Later guidance is final minus first-complete-target credits. Cumulative readings must not be added.
stressTest.coverageNote: Every frozen subcase is required for a pass. Automatic cross-tab refresh can prevent an intentionally stale form from remaining available; an unexercised stale prerequisite is a coverage gap, not a demonstrated race defect. The keyboard scenario specifies request search and a rejection-reason dialog, whereas the authoring prompts allow other interfaces. A different interface is not automatically a requested-feature defect. Earlier historical evidence and post-correction rechecks remain distinct; no source or data is altered to force a test precondition.
stressTest.limitation: Controlled same-context local simulations and sampled accessibility do not establish production concurrency, real authorization or accessibility certification. The selected Cowork model does not prove every internal app-building worker used that model. Compare only within this test, not against Tests 1-3 scores or averages.
stressTest.followupNote: The original GPT Medium observation is retained alongside four separately registered follow-ups using the identical original prompts, fixtures, rubrics and authoring/correction limits. Original outcomes are not overwritten. All four follow-ups are closed. This is a disclosed follow-up comparison, not five original first attempts; unfinished or unaccepted spend is excluded from accepted-app averages.
